$$11+3=14.$$

$$8+4=12.$$

$$|Q|\le6+4+2+2=14.$$

$$|Q|\le3+4+3+3=13.$$

$$|Q|\le4+4+4=12.$$

$$\boxed{\beta(H_0)=14.}$$

$$\begin{array}{ll}
p\ge3:&
\beta(G_{p,k})=7pk,\qquad |S|=8pk,\qquad |S|-\beta(G_{p,k})=pk;\\[2mm]
